lessons_used: Evidence for specific kinds of change is still thin, as each category has only 1 test so far.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests compared to noise-corrected results.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Name & Badge Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate layout into a split view featuring a custom name input component and an official pet adoption badge.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is low at 60.9% with an 89s median duration; a visual certificate redesign increases engagement during pet naming.

adoption_certificate.headline: Make It Official!
adoption_certificate.body: Give your new desktop companion a name and receive your official adoption badge.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.components[0]': inputs may only ask for the pet's name

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Docking Tips Screen
candidates.change: Add a new screen 'new_pet_docking_guide' before home_intro to visually guide users on how to move, hide, and talk to their desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support emails report post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or hide pets on the desktop.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready!
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_pet_docking_guide']

candidates.title: Move Sign-In After Adoption Selection
candidates.change: Reorder the sign-in step to occur after pet selection and certificate creation so users build an emotional bond before creating an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in right at the start has a 76.9% conversion; moving account creation after custom pet setup improves user motivation.

sign_in.headline: Save Your New Pet
sign_in.body: Sign in now to save your custom pet progress and cloud sync settings.

guard.reason: Reordering sign_in to occur after adoption is explicitly allowed under Rule 4 and retains all steps.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in reduces early friction but requires major architectural flow changes.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Rendering Waiting Stage
candidates.change: Transform the waiting screen into a dynamic stage layout complete with background progress indicators, tip carousels, and pet animations.
candidates.why: The waiting step has high median delay (201s) and long mean time (2336s), leading to user dropoff while waiting for pet asset rendering.

waiting.headline: Bringing Your Pet to Life...
waiting.body: We are generating your desktop companion's animations.

guard.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen into a dynamic stage layout preserves its job of showing the pet being made.

candidates.score_note: Complex wait stage layout change requires new screens/assets with weak prior performance for wait screens.

candidates.title: Path Choice Desktop Pet Style Hint
candidates.change: Add clear microcopy hints to the path options detailing preset adoption versus photo-based custom pet creation.
candidates.why: Choose path takes a median of 8s with 76.2% conversion; clear hints help users quickly select the right creation route.

choose_path.hint: Select Quick Preset for ready-made pets, or Custom Creator to generate from photos.

guard.reason: Adding descriptive microcopy to choose_path retains options for both adopting and making your own pet.

candidates.score_note: Simple hint text addition to path choice; quick config update with solid expected lift.

candidates.title: Cloud Backup Sign-In Assurance Copy
candidates.change: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that sign-in protects against pet loss or reset.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails complaining that pets were missing or reset after signing in.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Companion & Cloud Save
sign_in.body: Sign in to keep your pet saved across app restarts and prevent data loss.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to emphasize cloud save and data security stays within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails and sign-in dropoff; copy change is config-only.

candidates.title: Live Pet Generation Time Estimate Banner
candidates.change: Display explicit live time estimates and countdown status on the waiting screen while rendering pet assets.
candidates.why: Waiting time has a 201s median and a 2336s mean; showing time estimates reduces uncertainty and dropouts.

waiting.hint: Pet generation typically takes 1 to 3 minutes. Please stay on this screen.

guard.reason: Displaying a time estimate for an actual asset generation wait is permitted under fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Previous wait_info test yielded 0% lift; low confidence despite addressable wait time.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Ready Notification Opt-In
candidates.change: Add a desktop notification switch to alert users when pet asset generation finishes in the background.
candidates.why: Long wait times during home generation cause users to switch windows and abandon onboarding.

guard.reason: Adding an optional ready notification toggle on the waiting screen is a valid onboarding enhancement.

candidates.score_note: Desktop notification switch helps long wait dropouts; requires OS permission hooks.

candidates.title: Two-Column Pick Friend Selection Layout
candidates.change: Change pick_friend screen layout to a two-column design with choice cards for faster side-by-side companion preview.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9% and a 89s median completion time.

guard.reason: Changing pick_friend to a two-column layout preserves the screen's core job of choosing a companion.

candidates.score_note: Targets lowest conversion step (60.9%); layout redesign showed +1.9% lift in prior test.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Quick Controls Summary
candidates.change: Update the home intro text with quick desktop control instructions for summoning, moving, and hiding the pet.
candidates.why: Support logged 3 emails regarding post-onboarding confusion on pet controls and 4 emails on misbehaving features.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Your Desktop Pet!
home_intro.body: Tip: Right-click your pet anytime to access controls, switch modes, or hide companion to tray.

guard.reason: Updating home_intro text with desktop control tips is a valid copy change inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High impact dropoff step backed by 7 support emails; quick copy update.

picked: Path Choice Desktop Pet Style Hint

decisions.title: Path Choice Desktop Pet Style Hint

lessons_next: Evidence for specific kinds of change remains thin, as each kind of change has only 1 test so far.
Sign-in hint (sign_in, hint) and sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) were helpful as both won their tests.
Finish copy changes (finish, copy) performed worse and hurt the finish rate.
No clear effect was seen for adoption, choose_path, finish (new_screen), and home changes.
Predictions were generally too high across almost all tests compared to noise-corrected results.
Predictions were too low for sign-in reordering (+1.5% predicted vs +6.6% noise-corrected).
